environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with ALB. KEY_PROVIDER=pkcs11 configured with AWS CloudHSM cluster (2 HSMs in multi-AZ). PKCS#11 signing operations use CKA_SIGN with session object handles that are bound per-connection via the CloudHSM JCE provider's connection pooling with max-sessions=1 per task. The HSM enforces CKM_SHA256_HMAC with a minimum operation latency of 12ms per sign call due to network round-trip to HSM partition. ALB idle timeout set to 5s. CloudHSM audit logging enabled with CloudWatch integration. The PKCS#11 wrapper module implements a mutex-guarded session queue (capacity=1) that serializes all cryptographic operations through a single HSM session handle per process, creating a natural serialization point that collapses the race window to sub-microsecond timing between the signature verification return and the token deletion.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB idle_timeout=5s, CloudHSM cluster (2 HSMs), PKCS#11 mutex session queue capacity=1 per process
config.concurrency: single HSM session per process serializes sign operations
